episodes.synopsis:
The Morfonica members are excited for the concert-packed summer vacation.

Meanwhile, Toko secretly plans what she calls the "Summer Morfonica Plan" with Nanami and Tsukushi.
episodes.title: Summer Morfonica Plan

episodes.synopsis:
Mashiro is feeling down from her encounter with her old classmates.

Others in Morfonica try to help her out.

Summer vacation starts, and they carry out "Tsukinomori Camp" to make a new song.
episodes.title: Shining days
